conclusions: Two of three candidates now have real browser transcript parity with their Node baselines, on WebGPU, in the established harness.
Both passing graphs are our own fp32 exports; the one that fails is the third-party dynamic-int8 graph, which is consistent with the EP-kernel hypothesis for DynamicQuantizeLinear/MatMulInteger.
fp32 self-export, not the repacked int8, is the path that carries to the browser.
known_limitations: Token ids are reported as an empty list: the page's returnTokenIds option does not populate tokens for these families, so per-frame token evidence is absent from the browser receipts.
The omnilingual run used the JFK fixture; its own four-language fixtures were not re-run in the browser yet.
One browser run per configuration; no repeat-stability or long-form browser evidence.
